title: Fppf covering families are fpqc covering families
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{f_\alpha:T_\alpha\to T\}_{\alpha\in A}$ be an fppf covering family [def-pc-fppf-site]. Then this same family is an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. In particular, for each affine open $V\subseteq T$ there are finitely many indices $\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n$ and affine opens $W_j\subseteq T_{\alpha_j}$ with $\bigcup_{j=1}^n f_{\alpha_j}(W_j)=V$; $n=0$ is allowed when $V=\varnothing$.
